intro.background: 教玩具到了客户现场需要组装。KD包装就是为了现场安装。你需要提供：安装说明书（Assembly Manual）、工具清单、安装视频、技术支持。客户可能自己装，也可能请当地工人装。英语沟通要点：step by step、hardware、screw、wrench、level、tighten。
intro.desc: 掌握现场安装指导的英语表达。

oneLiner.en: KD packing means the customer assembles on site — your manual and video are as important as the product.
oneLiner.cn: KD包装意味着客户现场组装——你的说明书和视频和产品一样重要。

vocab.ex: We provide a detailed assembly manual.
vocab.exCn: 我们提供详细安装说明书。

vocab.ex: All hardware is included in the kit.
vocab.exCn: 所有五金件在配件包里。

vocab.ex: Follow the instructions step by step.
Use a level to ensure it is straight.
Tighten all screws at the end.
We also provide a video guide.

mistakes.right: Please follow the assembly manual step by step. We also provide a video guide.
mistakes.cn: 错误：说装起来就行。要提供说明书和视频。

basic.en: Tighten all screws at the end.

advanced.en: Each product comes with a fully illustrated assembly manual, all required hardware pre-packaged, and a QR code linking to a step-by-step video guide.
advanced.cn: 每个产品配完整图文说明书、预装五金件、扫码看分步视频指导。

advanced.en: If any parts are missing during installation, please email us the part number and photos — we will ship replacement parts by express within 48 hours.
advanced.cn: 安装时如缺件，请邮件发零件号和照片——我们48小时内快递补发。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: How do we assemble the furniture? Is it difficult?

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Not at all. Each piece comes with an illustrated assembly manual and a QR code for the video guide. All hardware is included. Two people can assemble one set in about 2 hours.
lines.cn: 一点不难。每件配图文说明书和扫码视频指导。所有五金件都有。两个人2小时装一套。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: What if some parts are missing?

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Please email us the part number and photos. We will ship replacements by express within 48 hours at no cost.
lines.cn: 请邮件发零件号和照片。我们48小时内免费快递补发。

scenario.q: A client asks how to assemble the furniture. Reply.
scenario.modelAnswer: Each product comes with a fully illustrated assembly manual, all required hardware pre-packaged, and a QR code linking to a step-by-step video. Two people can assemble one set in about 2 hours. If any parts are missing, email us the part number and photos — we will ship replacements within 48 hours.
scenario.cn: 每个产品配图文说明书、预装五金件、扫码分步视频。两个人2小时一套。如缺件邮件发零件号和照片——48小时内补发。

culture.title: 安装是售后的开始
culture.content: 教玩具的安装投诉率很高。说明书做精美、视频拍清楚、缺件响应快——这三点做好，客户复购率翻倍。很多厂产品质量好但安装烂，导致差评。

rounds.ai: How do we assemble the furniture?
What if some parts are missing?

rounds.hint: 配内六角，普通十字螺丝刀即可。
